_notes: Decision list populated by the /check-for-updates skill (see .claude/skills/check-for-updates/SKILL.md). This never changes authoritative site data automatically — same discipline as public-record-impact.json and review-proposals.json. A finding only becomes real content when a human (the maintainer) reviews it, and only becomes an authoritative fact when promoted through the normal SIDEQUEST.md workflow.

impactClassVocabulary.no_new_content: Source was checked; nothing has been published since the last check.
impactClassVocabulary.already_covered: Source had new content, but every fact in it already exists on the site (checked via grep against data/*.json before this classification is used, same as the manual process this file's first entries came from).
impactClassVocabulary.candidate_new_fact: Genuinely new information with no existing goalId/field it cleanly corrects or extends. Decision-list only — does not get a matching review-proposals.json entry.
impactClassVocabulary.candidate_goal_update: New information that maps cleanly to a specific existing goalId and field. Also gets a matching pending entry in data/review-proposals.json.
impactClassVocabulary.pending_verification: A possible lead (most often from the general web-search source) that could not be confirmed against primary-source text in this pass. Treat as provisional, never published as fact.

methodology: Detection never changes authoritative classifications automatically. Every finding is cross-checked against the current contents of data/*.json before being recorded, so that a source being read again does not produce a duplicate finding for a fact this site already carries.

findings.title: OSR 4th Annual Live Green Awards — nominations open, ceremony January 2027 at Proximity Hotel
findings.finding: The City's own site confirms/expands the CSC minutes' brief mention that the Live Green Awards return to the Proximity Hotel in January, with nomination details (deadline December 5) and a '4th annual' designation.
findings.limitation: An awards/recognition program is not evidence of SEP goal progress, funding, or a reporting gap — it doesn't fit this site's tracked-goal scope, same reasoning that excluded OMRI landfill certification and curbside composting earlier. Recorded here as a documented judgment call, not published to the site.
